stories.label: Iran war Day 8: Ground phase begins — US arms Kurdish guerrillas, Iran strikes preemptively
stories.summary: Day 8: War entering ground phase. US arming Kurdish guerrillas to infiltrate Iran from Iraq. Iran preemptively striking Kurdish groups. Iranian drones hit Azerbaijan airport — war spilling into non-combatant neighbors. Pentagon planning for war through September. Turkey warning PJAK threatens regional stability.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 8: Pacific islands and Cuba hit by fuel crisis, oil up 3%
stories.summary: Hormuz sealed Day 8. Oil up 3% today. Cuba blackout from fuel shortage. Pacific islands facing unaffordable price hikes with no alternatives. Trump says Navy will escort tankers. Economic blast radius reaching most vulnerable nations first — those with no domestic production and no strategic reserves.

stories.label: Evo 2: AI can write entire genomes — synthetic life question now open
stories.summary: Nature paper: Evo 2 AI model trained on 128,000 genomes (9.3T nucleotides) can design functional genomes across all domains of life. Already generating working synthetic gene regulatory elements. Biosecurity governance not keeping pace with capability.

stories.label: Lebanon: Israeli ground offensive continues, south of Litani evacuated
stories.summary: Israeli ground offensive ongoing. All south of Litani evacuated. 72+ killed since Monday. Hezbollah retaliating with drone swarms. Not covered this cycle but still developing.

stories.label: Nepal votes: first election since Gen Z protests toppled government
stories.summary: Voting completed March 5. ~25% turnout by midday. Results expected within days. Balen Shah a serious PM contender. Not re-selected this cycle — wait for results.

stories.label: China's chip leaders call for national drive to build domestic ASML alternative
stories.summary: NPC sessions: top semiconductor executives call industry 'small, fragmented and weak,' urge 'abandon illusions and prepare for struggle.' Without EUV lithography, China can't make chips below 7nm for AI. ASML machines cost $380M each.

stories.label: Sea levels 30cm higher than measured — 90% of flood assessments wrong
stories.summary: Nature study: 90% of coastal flood assessments underestimate baseline sea levels by average 30cm. Flood maps, insurance calculations, and climate adaptation plans worldwide built on wrong numbers. Millions more at risk than models show.

stories.label: Somalia approves official constitution after 30+ years without one
stories.summary: Parliament approved all 13 chapters. First official constitution since 1991. Watch for implementation, Somaliland response, al-Shabaab reaction.

stories.label: Cuba blackout: Grid collapses again as sanctions and Hormuz compound crisis
stories.summary: Another massive blackout Thursday leaving millions in western Cuba without power. Grid collapsing under compound pressures: crumbling Soviet-era infrastructure, US sanctions halting Venezuelan oil, Hormuz cutting alternative fuel. Recovery could take days.

stories.label: UK stops student visas for nationals from four war-torn countries
stories.summary: UK Home Office stops student visas for Afghanistan, Cameroon, Myanmar, Sudan nationals. Also stops work visas for Afghans. Says people using education visas to seek asylum. All four countries have active armed conflict or authoritarian rule.

stories.label: Gaza: Aid collapses under Iran war cover — siege tightens unseen
stories.summary: Aid entirely cut off. Crossings sealed. Siege tightening while world watches Iran. Continuation is the story.

stories.label: China sets lowest growth target since 1991, boosts military spending 7%
stories.summary: NPC: 4.5-5% growth target, 7% military spending increase, 10% science budget boost. Chip leaders calling for 'China's ASML.' Birth-friendly society pledge.

stories.label: US Senate blocks war powers resolution, greenlighting open-ended Iran war
stories.summary: Senate Republicans blocked Tim Kaine's war powers resolution. Congress has effectively greenlit open-ended war.

stories.label: Ukrainian naval drones sink Russian LNG tanker in Mediterranean
stories.summary: Arctic Metagaz LNG tanker sunk between Libya and Malta. Farthest-reaching Ukrainian maritime strike.

stories.label: First wrongful death lawsuit against Google over Gemini AI chatbot
stories.summary: Family sues Google after 36-year-old man's death. First wrongful death case over AI chatbot.

stories.label: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs may halve risk of drug addiction — BMJ study
stories.summary: BMJ study: GLP-1 agonists could halve substance abuse deaths. Nature follow-up article also covering this.

stories.label: South Africa's biggest AI data centre to consume 25% of Durban's electricity
stories.summary: 400MW AI data centre planned. Would consume 25% of Durban's electricity in a city with load-shedding.

stories.label: Big Tech's Gulf data megaprojects trapped between two war chokepoints
stories.summary: Only two data routes in/out of Gulf both in conflict zones. Digital economy's physical geography vulnerability exposed.

stories.label: Nestlé sells baby cereal with 15% sugar in Africa, zero in Europe
stories.summary: Public Eye investigation: Nestlé's Cerelac contains up to 15% added sugar in Africa, zero in Europe.

stories.label: UK arrests Labour MP's husband and two others for China espionage
stories.summary: Three men arrested for spying for China, including husband of a Labour MP.

stories.label: Google ends 30% app store fee, opens to third-party stores
stories.summary: Google drops 30% Play Store commission. Forced by antitrust and EU DMA.

stories.label: PM Abiy warns Eritrea; 41 countries warn press freedom shrinking before election
stories.summary: PM Abiy warned Eritrea. Ethiopia-Kenya joint military ops. 41 countries caution shrinking civic space undermines election. Still uncovered.

stories.label: China sustains hours-long laser link with satellite 40,000km up
stories.summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences sustained high-speed laser communication with geostationary satellite.

stories.label: AI translations injecting fabricated information into Wikipedia
stories.summary: AI-translated Wikipedia articles swapping sources, adding unsourced sentences.

stories.label: AI avatar 'Gaitana' running to represent Indigenous voters in Colombia
stories.summary: Digital AI avatar is public stand-in for two real Indigenous candidates in Colombia.

stories.label: Children's mole count halved in 25 years — sun campaigns changing bodies
stories.summary: 25-year study: mole count dropped from 87 to 46. Sun protection campaigns changing children's skin.

stories.label: Sudan: War grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: War continues. UK just stopped student visas for Sudanese nationals. Need anchoring development to re-enter coverage.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia: attention diverted by Iran war, strikes at 3-year peak
stories.summary: Iran war diverting weapons and attention. 288 missiles in February — 3-year high. Russian drone struck civilian cargo ship in Black Sea.

stories.label: 1.1 million Filipino overseas workers at risk across Middle East
stories.summary: 1.1M Filipino OFWs trapped. Evacuation flights underway.

stories.label: CBP used ad-tech data to track phones without warrants
stories.summary: Internal DHS document confirms CBP used ad ecosystem location data to track phones without warrants.
